comparison.objective: Candidate installs and recovers temporary lifting hardware while transferring a workpiece; record tightens a started bracket bolt with a ratchet in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests button-actuated ball locking, shackle handling, suspended placement, and extraction; record tests socket engagement and repeated short ratchet strokes that advance a threaded fastener.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires pull retention, lift height, three-pad support, safe withdrawal, and clearance; record requires measured axial bolt advance, actual head/bracket contact, thread integrity, and continuous seating.
comparison.reason: Both involve mechanical engagement, but the record's defining ability is confined ratcheting and fastener seating, not lifting-pin retention or load transfer; all spec versions were readable.
